summary: Completed backend pytest and frontend Playwright testing for ORYNVE storefront/admin. Public storefront routes load and core public APIs work, but admin authentication is blocked by origin enforcement (403), which prevents CMS/owner flows.

critical.issue: Returns 403 'Request origin is not permitted.' even when called from the production frontend origin; admin login/refresh/logout and all admin mutation flows are blocked.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated behavior correctly returns 401; could not fully validate authenticated CRUD due auth-origin blocker.

ui_bugs.issue: Wishlist button click did not toggle via normal Playwright click in repeated runs (aria-pressed stayed false); DOM-level click toggled to true.

integration_issues.issue: Correct credentials cannot sign in because backend auth POST is blocked by 403 origin rejection; owner CMS flows (draft/preview/publish/media/toggles/revisions/activity) are not testable end-to-end.

issues: No horizontal overflow found on desktop/mobile/tablet for /, /shop, /product/the-form-overcoat, /collections, /contact.

action_items: Fix strict origin validation logic for /api/auth and /api/admin mutations so production frontend requests are accepted.

After auth fix, retest complete owner CMS scope: products/collections/pages/nav/footer edits, save draft->preview->publish, revisions/discard/revert, feature toggles/site mode, media upload/edit/delete reference protection, activity export/status updates.
Investigate ProductCard wishlist hit-target behavior in shop grid (normal click not toggling in automation while DOM click works).
critical_code_review_comments: Security middleware enforces exact Origin match for auth/admin writes and currently rejects legitimate frontend calls in this deployment, effectively taking down owner authentication and CMS operations.
Origin check likely needs resilient handling for proxied deployments (e.g., normalized origin sources) while preserving CSRF protections.
Auth failure prevents validating cookie rotation/logout revocation at runtime despite implementation being present in code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public storefront loads and /api/store,/api/orders/prepare,/api/sitemap.xml,/api/robots.txt work. Backend pytest report exists. Critical blocker: auth/admin POST origin rejection (403) with valid owner credentials. Admin dashboard screenshot could not be captured because login never succeeds. Mobile homepage/shop/product and tablet/home screenshots captured under /app/test_reports/artifacts.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST https://premium-orynve.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login with Origin=https://premium-orynve.preview.emergentagent.com returns 403. Same in browser admin UI with valid credentials. Backend middleware in server.py rejects POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to /api/auth and /api/admin when request.headers.origin does not exactly match configured FRONTEND_URL. In current deployment path, legitimate requests are failing that comparison; result blocks all owner auth and secured CMS actions. Mitigation: normalize/verify trusted origin handling for ingress/proxy headers while maintaining CSRF controls, then rerun full admin workflow regression.
